descriptionPlain:
About Initech
At Initech, we help developers and data teams take flight by unlocking the power of real-time data to build data products faster. With Initech, developers can easily ingest data from multiple sources, query it using the SQL they already know and love, and publish results as low-latency, high-concurrency APIs for their applications — all in minutes, not hours or days.

Our mission is to make real-time data accessible and actionable for every developer. Initech is loved by develo
